svg.title: Storefront at dusk — A · Bazaar — Curry District signage concept
svg.desc: Illustrative storefront — not your actual unit. Same unit at dusk: halo + face-lit letters, festoon bulbs on the awning, "Chai-lo!" LED neon and warm window light spilling onto the walk.
